test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Article 21A was added to the Constitution of India by which constitutional amendment act?
solution:
The correct answer is __**86th Constitutional Amendment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 86th Amendment Act was enacted on** December 12, 2002.**
 
• The most notable feature of the 86th Amendment is the insertion of **Article 21A into the Constitution.**
 
• Article 21A established the **right to education** as a fundamental right under the Constitution.
 
• The Act led to the introduction of the **Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act in 2009**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **42nd Amendment Act** was Passed during the Emergency on **December 18, 1976.**
 
• Introduced **Article 51A**, which enumerates the fundamental duties of citizens.
 
• The Preamble was amended to include the words **"socialist" and "secular"** and to emphasize the unity and integrity of the nation.
 
• The 42nd Amendment is often referred to as the **"Mini-Constitution"** due to its comprehensive changes.
 
• **93rd Amendment Act Passed on January 20, 2006.**
 
• Added provisions for the reservation of seats for the **Other Backward Classes (OBCs)** in educational institutions funded by the government.
 
• **Article 15 **was amended to allow for the advancement of any socially and educationally backward classes of citizens.
 
• **94th Amendment Act was Enacted on August 18, 2006.**
 
• Provided for the reservation of seats for the **Scheduled Castes (SCs) and Scheduled Tribes (STs)** in every local body, including Panchayati Raj institutions.
 
• Clarified provisions regarding the **reservation of seats for women in addition to SC/ST** reservations.
